correctness.rationale: The augmented chains decompose into characters using normalized plus/minus eigenvectors in each selected clique; the local swap action and boundary augmentation make the chi_S block the augmented link complex shifted by |S|. The complement of the closed neighborhood of independent S decomposes into exact path lengths max(delta-3,0). The P_m three-step recurrence and cycle deletion cofibration give precisely the claimed one-dimensional or rank-two rational homology in the stated degrees, including delta=2,3, S=empty and singleton boundary cases. The packaged verifier checks total mod-101 homology and signed Lefschetz traces against these formulas for finite n but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The canonical clique-doubled cycle has n independent local transpositions and thus 2^n characters; previously known Betti numbers cannot recover which characters appear. The theorem determines every isotypic degree, proves a nontrivial multiplicity-one phenomenon for nonempty supports, and relates occurrence to the topology of cyclic gaps via a sharp mod-three obstruction. It is an infinite-family structure theorem with a reusable equivariant link-chain mechanism, beyond arbitrary finite enumeration; it does not rely on claims of a new nonequivariant sphere-wedge theorem.
